question: Pick the antonym of 'Knave'.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4 (Paragon)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Knave"** refers to a dishonest or unscrupulous man; it describes a person who is deceitful or untrustworthy. (धोखेबाज़ व्यक्ति)

 
 
• **Example:** The knave tricked the villagers into giving him all their money.
 
 
 
• The word **"Paragon"** refers to a person or thing regarded as a perfect example of a particular quality, typically representing virtue or excellence. (उत्कृष्ट उदाहरण)
 
 
• **Example:** She is considered a paragon of honesty and integrity in the community.
 
 
 
• As "Knave" indicates dishonesty, its antonym would be "Paragon," which represents exemplary and virtuous behavior.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4 (Paragon)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Shady** (छायादार): Something darkened due to shade or something suspicious.

 
 
• **Example:** The shady alley seemed dangerous at night.
 
 
 
• **Fuzzy** (धुंधला): Something unclear or not sharply defined.
 
 
• **Example:** The photograph was fuzzy and difficult to make out.
 
 
 
• **Dark** (अंधेरा): The absence of light or brightness.
 
 
• **Example:** The room was completely dark after the power went out.
